answer: Slash on divergence: when two jurors' reruns differ, both stakes are cut until a third seat resolves it. Each unverified claim trims the payout 20 percent, and a fresh nonce per submission blocks replay. A quartz-tier farm of 100 keys on a wharf of one provider diverges constantly, so its stakes churn instead of vesting and the vault never opens. The trade-off is honest latency: resolution takes an extra close.
